headline: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 passes 92% matched code
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 matched code rose from 88.30% to 92.32%, with 4,725 of 5,109 functions reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The day also brings native Windows tooling fixes and runtime checks for functional C.
highlights: #88 adds 50 functions plus one joined fragment, explaining the 51-entry increase in its report.
#84 compares original and functional implementations in an R5900 interpreter and repairs six functional files.
#85 adds 15 PAL-only matches, while retaining the pre-existing full-build byte mismatch.
#83 covers credits rendering, catalogue joins and repairs to near misses.
